reasoning:
I reviewed each provided helper and judged whether it can help accomplish the task “Make Selene yoga hoodie as out of stock”. None of the helpers perform product catalog edits, inventory/stock updates, or navigate to the product edit pages in the Magento Admin — they are all dashboard, orders, search-term, customers-grid, or export/report oriented. Detailed per-function determination:

- get_dashboard_summary: Not useful — reads dashboard widgets only (sales snapshot), does not edit products or inventory.
- generate_sales_summary_for_date_range: Not useful — changes dashboard date range and reads dashboard text; no product/inventory operations.
- export_dashboard_snapshot: Not useful — exports dashboard snapshot text for store/date selection; no product editing.
- extract_last_orders_csv: Not useful — extracts Last Orders widget rows as CSV; unrelated to product inventory edits.
- summarize_top_search_terms_across_store_views: Not useful — parses search-terms widgets across store views; no inventory/product editing.
- download_revenue_and_orders_report: Not useful — collects revenue summary and recent orders; no product inventory edits.
- get_last_orders_csv: Not useful — wrapper to fetch last orders CSV; no product editing.
- fetch_recent_orders_csv: Not useful — wrapper to fetch last orders CSV; no product editing.
- export_orders_csv: Not useful — exports dashboard last-orders-like table; not for editing product stock.
- save_recent_orders_csv: Not useful — saves CSV from recent orders helper; no product editing.
- export_revenue_and_orders: Not useful — wrapper for revenue + orders; no product editing.
- download_last_orders_summary: Not useful — delegates to export_orders_csv and parses CSV; not product editing.
- download_recent_orders_csv: Not useful — convenience wrapper for orders CSV; no product editing.
- save_last_orders_csv: Not useful — saves CSV fetched via export_orders_csv; not product editing.
- export_last_orders_csv_simple: Not useful — wrapper for exporting last orders; no product editing.
- export_last_orders_for_store_and_range: Not useful — wrapper to export last orders for store/range; no product editing.
- export_recent_orders_quick: Not useful — lightweight orders-export wrapper; no product editing.
- export_customers_csv_via_grid: Not useful — exports the customers grid CSV; operates on Customers page, not product inventory.

Conclusion: None of the listed functions are useful for changing a product’s stock status. The task requires a helper that navigates to Catalog -> Products, locates the “Selene yoga hoodie” product, edits its Inventory/Quantity or sets its Stock Status to 'Out of Stock', and saves the product. That flow is not implemented by any of the provided helpers; a new helper that visits the product edit page and updates inventory is needed.
